messages:
tara (eng-runtime): quick sync — we need a concrete list of kvcache / prefix-cache metrics for the dashboard + alerting. goal: per-workload reuse, global hit-rate, and eviction signals that the console + routing teams can use for rollouts.

mike (eng-platform): +1. we also need to decide label strategy (tenant/model/workload/region). cardinality is a big concern.

jay (eng-infra): i can add counters and histograms at the runtime edge. proposing these metric names: `kvcache.prefix_hit_total`, `kvcache.prefix_miss_total`, `kvcache.evictions_total`, `kvcache.reuse_by_workload_total`, `kvcache.kv_size_bytes`, `kvcache.lookup_latency_seconds_bucket`. thoughts?

satya (observability): those names look good. please include labels: `tenant`, `model`, `workload`, `region`, `backend` (hosted/dedicated/private). for reuse_by_workload_total we should also emit `workload_type` (chat/generation/embedding) to make heatmaps easier.

lina (console): we need a UX-friendly rollup for the console: overall hit rate (last 1h/24h), per-workload rank ordered by impact (requests * (1-hit_rate)). can we provide a precalculated `kvcache.hit_rate_ratio` gauge?

jay (eng-infra): prefer calculating in Prometheus to avoid extra exporters, but we can emit a derived gauge at instrument time if it simplifies things for console queries. downside = more cardinality.

dan (sre): alerting proposal: fire if `rate(kvcache.evictions_total[5m]) > 0.5 * rate(kvcache.prefix_miss_total[5m])` for 15m or if `kvcache.prefix_hit_total / (kvcache.prefix_hit_total + kvcache.prefix_miss_total) < 0.7` (1h drop) for critical tenants. also add a rolling change alert if hit rate drops by >15% vs 24h baseline.

tara (eng-runtime): implementation notes: runtime will emit per-request label `prefix_hit=true/false` (counter increment) and include `prefix_length` bucket so we can analyze whether short/long prefixes have different hit patterns. sample instrumentation: 
```
// pseudo-code in runtime request path
labels = {tenant, model, workload, region, backend}
if (prefix_cache.hit(req)) {
  metrics.counter("kvcache.prefix_hit_total", labels).inc()
  metrics.histogram("kvcache.prefix_length", labels).observe(req.prefix_len)
} else {
  metrics.counter("kvcache.prefix_miss_total", labels).inc()
}
// eviction callback
metrics.counter("kvcache.evictions_total", labels + {eviction_policy}) .inc()
```

mike (eng-platform): on aggregation: console should show both `by tenant` and `by workload` rollups. for low-cardinality global panels, we can `sum by (region)`, but we must provide pre-built recording rules: 
- `record: kvcache:hit_rate:1h` -> `sum(rate(kvcache.prefix_hit_total[1h])) / sum(rate(kvcache.prefix_hit_total[1h]) + rate(kvcache.prefix_miss_total[1h]))`
- `record: kvcache:eviction_rate:5m` -> `sum(rate(kvcache.evictions_total[5m]))`
these make dashboard queries cheap.

satya (observability): agree on recording rules. also recommend histograms for `lookup_latency_seconds` to diagnose cache-induced latency spikes. add a counter for `kvcache.backend_fallback_total` when lookup falls back to slower store (s3/kvstore).

lina (console): small ask for rollouts UX: the rollout page wants a tie-in metric `kvcache.fallback_ratio` per model so when we push a quantized variant we can see if it causes more fallbacks/evictions. can we expose: `kvcache.fallback_ratio = rate(kvcache.backend_fallback_total[5m]) / rate(kvcache.lookup_total[5m])` as a recording rule?

jay (eng-infra): yes. we'll add `kvcache.lookup_total` counter. runtime can emit it alongside hits/misses.

dan (sre): one more: export `kvcache.prefetch_success_total` and `kvcache.prefetch_attempt_total` so we can track prefetch effectiveness. prefetch inefficiency correlates with evictions.

tara (eng-runtime): noted. also we should cap label cardinality on `model` by providing `model_family` label (e.g., vicuna-13b, llama-2-70b) to avoid high-cardinality when customers pin model commits.

satya (observability): good catch. also limit `tenant` to hashed_id and provide a `tenant_tier` label (free/paid/enterprise) for tiered dashboards.

mike (eng-platform): next steps: jay to PR runtime metric names + example emitters; satya to propose Prom recording rules; lina to draft dashboard wireframe with required panels and alert thresholds; dan to write alerting playbook. then sync next Wed.

jay (eng-infra): i'll open the PR today with the instrumentation stubs and a metrics README describing labels and cardinality guidance.

k8s-bot: deploy triggered: metrics-exporter v2.3.1 -> canary to infra-monitoring namespace.

tara (eng-runtime): thanks — tagging the rollout UX doc and a short eval plan in the PR. if we can get those recording rules in this sprint, console can ship the new panels for the canary. :thumbsup:

mike (eng-platform): thanks all. will add a short checklist in the PR: recording rules, dashboards, alerting rules, label limits, sample queries.

lina (console): ping me on the PR for dashboard wireframes, i have some ideas for the per-workload impact ranking panel.

end of thread.
